_about: Orchestra's model choices, in one place (AGENTS.md Rule 0). Kept apart from config.json so model changes don't collide with limit changes. Read by orchestra/local_team/core.py load_config(); a key here wins over the same key in config.json. Claude-lane models are picked per task by a 'Model:' header (runner.py), and the claude CLI's own default applies otherwise, so there is no claude/codex id here.
_local_team_model: Installed Ollama model the local team (scout/planner/librarian) calls; it never pulls one. See config.json's _local_team_model for the GPU-busy rules.
